text:
Jamie: Night shift canary check-in — starting thread.
Jamie: What I did: kicked off warmup for slice-7 at 02:00 UTC, ran smoke tests against /generate, p50 ~ 80ms, p95 ~ 220ms. Verified prefix caching enabled.
Jamie: Blockers: safety guard 'toxicity_filter_v2' tripped on 3 of 40 samples (minor). Also seeing occasional tokenization OOMs on quantized chat-model-3-q4; infra asked for logs. @Ravi @Sara please ack.
Jamie: Today: keep at 5% for another 30m, then try 10% if stable. Plan to flip feature flag `rflag_canary_night` to 10% routing after 02:35 UTC. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/rollouts/slice7
deploy-bot: Canary slice-7 warmup complete — routing 5% traffic to canary (us-west-2). :rocket:
Ravi: acked. Looking at the traces now — can you post the perf dashboard link? :eyes:
Jamie: Link above — click 'slice7' under Rollouts. Also logs: `kubectl logs -f canary-slice7 -n inference` gave the OOM stack.
Sara: Which safety check fired? I saw a spike with 'toxicity_filter_v2' — seems config mismatch between canary and baseline. I pushed a small rule set to staging earlier.
Miguel: If toxicity_filter_v2 fires >3 times in 15m we auto-fallback to non-quantized variant. I can lower threshold. Pushed hotfix to safety config, diff:
```
- allowed_toxicity_score: 0.7
+ allowed_toxicity_score: 0.65
```
Miguel: Also increased memory headroom on the pod template to 6Gi for q4 variants.
Ellie: Are eval golden set checks running against the canary? Need to ensure no regression on intent classification.
Jamie: Yes, eval-runner triggered at start, ETA ~30m for first batch. Pinning model version to `chat-model-3@v2.3.1-canary` for this slice.
Ravi: Thanks — I'll watch the anomaly alerts and ping if we hit >0.5% error rate. :thumbsup:
Sara: On call if we need to rollback. If toxicity repeats after Miguel's tweak, rollback to baseline immediately.
Jamie: Thanks all — will update here at next checkpoint (02:40 UTC).
